writing_principles: Each sentence was written as a plausible everyday exchange, with varied situations, roles, tone and grammatical structure.
No copied articles, dictionary sentence imports, Cartesian phrase assembly or template expansion.
Written before mechanical test-answer exclusion; test expected answers were not inspected for composition.
Includes natural causes, conditions, concessions, clarification, coordination and reassurance; does not force target homophones.
Test answers are excluded after normalization to Han characters, including matches crossing punctuation boundaries.
Exact duplicate sentences are removed within this file and against existing daily original corpora.
